<js>
json=[];
list=baseUrl.replace(/http.*?wd=\s*/,'').split('•');
for(i = 0;i<list.length-1;i++){
	let index = list[i].match(/【(.*?)】/)[1];
	let src = list[i].match(/@(.*?)@/)[1];
	let text = list[i].match(/《(.*?)》/)[1];
	let intro = list[i].match(/『(.*?)』/)[1];
	json.push({index:index,src:src,text:text,intro:intro})
	}
JSON.stringify(json)</js>
